summary: OSR Holdings, Inc. (OSRH) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a global exclusive license agreement with its largest shareholder, BCM Europe AG (BCME), for its VXM01 cancer immunotherapy platform. The agreement includes milestone payments up to $815M, a royalty pass-through structure, and an equity put option allowing OSRH to require BCME to purchase up to $15M of common stock at $10.00/share. A separate $30M asset purchase for related IP is planned. The board approved after a fairness opinion from Avance Life Sciences AG. This is a strategic licensing deal, not a classic special situation; watch for milestone achievement and potential equity dilution if the put is exercised.
